From the reflection, \(F=(1,2/3)\).

Line \(AF\): \(P = t(1,2/3)\).  
Line \(BE\): \(P = (1-\frac12 s, s)\).

Equating:
\[
t = 1-\frac12 s,\qquad \frac23 t = s
\]
so
\[
t = 1-\frac12\cdot \frac23 t = 1-\frac13 t
\]
\[
\frac43 t = 1 \implies t=\frac34.
\]

Thus
\[
\frac{AP}{PF} = \frac{t}{1-t} = \frac{3/4}{1/4}=3.
\]

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
